verdict.rationale: Usage analytics is a fair question for an MCP registry and connection platform. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents dashboards or metrics for call volumes, users, errors, or cost on consumed or published servers. The pack covers connections, publishing, token scoping, namespaces and the CLI, and the hosted services were shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost
